content.title: THE REAL REASON YOUR {{HEADACHES}} KEEP COMING BACK
facts: **Pumpkin seeds** – a handful (about 1 oz) daily supplies magnesium, which eases the blood vessel tension behind tension headaches.
**Dehydration** is the #1 trigger doctors see, yet most people blame everything else first. Start with 1-2 glasses of water before reaching for pills.
**Watermelon** – 1 cup after a workout or hot day replaces fluids and electrolytes faster than water alone.
**Skipped meals** drop your blood sugar and pull on blood vessels in the brain. A small snack every 3-4 hours keeps it steady.
**Ginger tea** – 1 cup at the first sign of a headache can calm nausea and dull throbbing pain.
**Almonds** – 10-12 a day deliver riboflavin, a B-vitamin linked to fewer migraine days.
**Dark chocolate** (70%+) in small amounts can ease a headache for some, but too much triggers one in others — know your own pattern.
**Bananas** – 1 a day replenishes potassium lost through sweat or caffeine, which can trigger throbbing pain.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
If headaches keep sneaking up on you, a few food tweaks might matter more than you think. Pumpkin seeds are loaded with magnesium, a mineral that relaxes blood vessel walls and calms the nerve signals that trigger tension headaches in the first place. Ginger works differently — it has natural anti-inflammatory compounds that can settle the stomach and reduce swelling around blood vessels when pain starts brewing. And bananas replace potassium you lose through sweating, caffeine, or stress, which matters because low potassium makes blood vessels more reactive to pain triggers. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to what actually helps yours.
